moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ui-toast, written here): Toast 180x40 r10 (light, green status dot, label) rises from below the frame (y 220 → 136, 84 px) on a spring k260 c22 from 0.3 s (≈ 400 ms); holds; slides back down over 2.6-2.85 s power2.in. Recipe: hold 3-5 s in a product; several toasts stack upward. Params: spring (k260 c22) · rise (84 px) · hold (2.3 s) · out (0.25 s, power2.in). In a product hold it 3–5 s; several toasts stack upward.
